sci-repo-y7-sby-simplemachines-folder201.title: Year 7 Science — Simple machines,levers,gears and pulleys (original source MC)
sci-repo-y7-sby-simplemachines-folder201.coverage: Original assessment questions with source figures. Written parts remain in the bank with marks and parent context. Review-required items excluded from automatic battles.

questions.prompt: When using a machine called a force magnifier you apply:
options: a small force over a large distance
a large force over a large distance
a small force over a small distance
a large force over a small distance
questions.explanation: A:smaller effort force applied over a greater distance,in the ideal force-magnifier model.

questions.prompt: The force you need to move an object is called the:
The chain wheel sprocket on a bike has 60 teeth and the rear wheel sprocket has 15 teeth.    The gear ratio for this bike is:
questions.explanation: D:60/15=4:1 under the front-teeth/rear-teeth convention used by the offered options. The rear sprocket rotates4times per front revolution. State the ratio convention explicitly;some engineering texts use the reciprocal driven/driver ratio.

questions.prompt: Indigenous stone tools were developed by a process called:
questions.explanation: D:flaking is the intended named technique. It can involve striking a core with a hammerstone;flaked stone tools are one part of diverse First Nations toolmaking traditions.

questions.prompt: What type of simple machine is found on a water bottle cap?
An eggbeater can be classed as a:
questions.explanation: B:speed magnifier for the usual hand-cranked geared eggbeater.

questions.prompt: Which of the following uses a wedge as a simple machine?
questions.explanation: C:axe,the blade acts as a wedge.

questions.prompt:
A number of interconnected gears are called a gear train. The force supplied is provided by the driving gear and force is transmitted to the driven gear. Select the correct response for the gears shown in the picture.
[LV-MEDIA:{"images":[{"pack":"repo-science-batch220","id":"e504-image3"}]}]
options: The driving wheel rotates faster than the driven wheel.
The driving wheel rotates slower than the driven wheel.
The driving wheel and the driven wheel rotate at the same speed.
The driving wheel and the driven wheel rotate in the same direction.
questions.explanation: A:smaller driving gear rotates faster than larger driven gear;meshed gears rotate in opposite directions.

questions.prompt:
A cable is positioned around a pulley as shown in the diagram below. A 10 kg and a 15 kg mass hang from each end of the cable. Select the correct response:
[LV-MEDIA:{"images":[{"pack":"repo-science-batch220","id":"e504-image4"}]}]
options: The 10 kg mass is moving downwards.
The 15 kg mass is moving upwards.
The 15 kg mass is moving downwards.
questions.explanation: D:15kg mass moves downward in the ideal freely moving system.
